name: Citadel Outlets
description: Citadel Outlets is Los Angeles' premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brands and restaurants in a distinctive Assyrian palace-inspired architectural setting. Located just minutes from downtown LA, LAX, and Southern California attractions, this open-air outlet center offers savings on top brands including adidas, Coach, Kate Spade, Levi's, lululemon, Michael Kors, Nike, The North Face, and Tory Burch. The center features unique attractions like the World's Tallest Christmas Tree during the holidays and serves as a major draw for both locals and international tourists visiting Southern California.
summary: Los Angeles' leading outlet shopping center featuring over 130 global brands in a unique Assyrian palace-themed architectural setting, minutes from downtown LA and major attractions.
